headline: Gisele Pelicot to sue publisher after n*de photos are used to promote book
label: NEWS
caption:
Gisele Pelicot said she feels once again humiliated and deeply shocked after n*de images of her were sent to media outlets to promote a book about coercive control. 💔

According to the BBC, the 73 year old announced she will take legal action against the publisher and author of the essay. The publisher Tinbad issued an apology and stated it would stop printing and promoting the work after sending the photos taken by her ex husband.

Pelicot told French broadcaster BFM TV that she is shocked to see her private life exploited for commercial purposes as if the ordeal of her trial had not been enough. Her lawyer Christophe Bigot stated that the book calls into question her status as a victim.

Pelicot became a global feminist icon after waiving her right to anonymity in the mass r@pe trial of her ex husband and dozens of other men in 2024.
